approvedDecisions.title: "repo" and "project" governed terms

definitions.repo: Any OS-accessible folder where a user works — local filesystem, NAS, or cloud-synced (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, LucidLink). May also be a git repository, gaining tracking, branching, and pull-based carry-forward. The harness provides capabilities (.aitools/) regardless of backing storage. Distinct from aitools repo and dotprofile repo (specific named repos).
definitions.project: The body of work a user develops or maintains within a repo — codebase, configuration, artifacts, and operational state. A repo contains one project. Project-scoped data lives in <repo>/.aitools/. Distinct from the scope modifier 'project' (which qualifies composed terms like 'project rule' for the current repo).
